fields.name: SpecifyProcessBy
fields.label: Specify process by
fields.description: Specifies whether to terminate the process by name or ID.

selectOptions.label: Process Name
selectOptions.description: Identifies the process by its name (e.g., notepad).

selectOptions.label: Process ID
selectOptions.description: Identifies the process by its unique numeric ID.

fields.name: ProcessName
fields.label: Process name
fields.description: The name of the process to terminate (only applicable if 'Specify process by' is set to 'Process name').

fields.name: ProcessId
fields.label: Process ID
fields.description: The ID of the process to terminate (only applicable if 'Specify process by' is set to 'Process ID').

fields.name: FromUser
fields.label: From User
fields.description: Indicates whether to check if the process is running under a specific user.

fields.name: UserName
fields.label: User name
fields.description: The name of the user to check (only applicable if 'From User' is enabled).

fields.name: StatusMessages
fields.label: Status Message
fields.description: Provides status information about the operation.
